ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver's "I'm Here" press for abuse review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he waited at least 5 minutes; the timeline and GPS trace show he pressed 'I'm Here' at 21:29:10 and cancelled at 21:30:55 (1 min 45 s, ~115 s stationary), well under the > 3 min required by NS-1(iii).

Rider says the driver cancelled barely two minutes after arriving; the trace shows the driver was at the pickup and did press 'I'm Here', so a brief wait did occur — but it still fails the 3-minute threshold, so the outcome (full refund) is unchanged.
